ActionView.description: What a pending action would do, in the user's terms.

autoStart.description: Whether the countdown runs (Settings → Meetings → start recording automatically).

deviceId.description: This device's sync id (base64 public key), if the identity loaded.

accounts.description: The accounts this could be done with, and the one used unless the user picks another.

action.description: `None` when the draft could not be read; it can still be rejected.

blocked.description: Why Approve cannot work yet (no account connected), or `None`.

summary.description: The routine's own one-line description of the draft.

approvals.description: The list as it is now.

message.description: What to tell the user: why it is still waiting, or that someone else already handled it.

BriefRecap.description:
Today's Daily Brief as the recap: the routine's own summary, from this PC or a synced device
(docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-17-today-recap-daily-brief-windows.md).

from.description: The device that ran it, when that is not this PC.

blocked.description:
Why calendar syncing can't run right now (no Node, connector not staged, sync not
configured), or `None` when it can.

lastSyncedUnixMs.description: When the last round finished, and why it failed if it did.

nextMeeting.description: The next one's title and start, for the card's line.

upcoming.description: Meetings still to come that a prompt could fire for.

source.description: `uia`, `ocr` (Windows) or `ax` (Mac); `None` for rows older than the field.
`uia`, `ocr` (Windows) or `ax` (Mac); `None` for rows older than the field.

excluded.description: Reads skipped because the window is excluded.

paused.description: Why capture is paused right now, if it is.

running.description: False if the service could not start (see `last_error`).

stored.description: Reads that produced new stored items.

unchanged.description: Reads skipped as near-identical to the window's last stored text.

ChatEvent.description: What the UI hears about one question, over a Tauri `Channel`.

oneOf.description:
The question is being answered. `run_id` is set while it streams (Stop cancels
it); `None` on the blocking path, where the UI shows a spinner.
The stream failed before any output; the blocking path is answering instead.
Stopped: the question goes back into the composer.
`partial`: some of the answer had streamed before it failed.
A new conversation got its generated title.

ChatSpend.description:
The Ask composer's "X¢ / cap¢ today". Spend is the anonymous identity's, which is
what the user cap gates.

oneOf.description: A daily spend cap rejected the call.
Every provider in the chain failed for a reason other than the cap.
The store actor failed: it could not open, it stopped, or a job panicked.
Credential Manager refused a read or write.
A network call (Worker, sync database, provider model list) failed.
A required setting or build-time secret is missing.
The UI sent something the shell can't act on.

ContextEntry.description:
One item the answer may cite. The UI matches a citation to it by `item`. A saved
exchange stores the entries it cited in this shape.

allOf.description: `{kind, id}`, exactly as a citation (`llm::ContextItemRef`) serializes.

open.description:
Where clicking the citation goes; `None` for routine runs and threads, which have
no Library view yet.

ContextItemRef.description:
A citation pointing back to one retrieved context item, tagged with which table
(`capture_item` or `transcript_segment`) the id belongs to — see [`ContextItem`]'s
doc comment for why a bare `i64` isn't safe here. `PartialOrd`/`Ord` (variant
declaration order, then field order) give `assemble_context` a deterministic tiebreak
for score ties, independent of `HashMap` iteration order in `rrf_fuse`.

DetectedMeeting.description:
A meeting Whimbrel is offering to record: a call it noticed, or a calendar event whose
lead window has opened (M3.3 Task 7).

attendees.description: A calendar meeting's invitees, which become the expected speaker count.

id.description: `detected-<app>-<epoch seconds>` from core's debounce, or the calendar event's id.

promptedUnixMs.description: When the alert appeared, for its countdown.

rootPid.description: The process tree to record, or 0 for a calendar meeting with no app in sight.

source.description: "detected" or "calendar": which trigger the meeting row gets.

startUnixMs.description:
A calendar meeting's own start, so the row spans the event, not the moment Accept
was pressed.

lastTsUnixMs.description: The newest capture today; `None` when the device captured nothing today.

comparisonCode.description: Short code both devices show while approving (`None` for an unparseable key).

id.description: The Worker's device id (what approve / revoke take).

publicKey.description: The device's public key, which is its `device_id` on timeline rows.

appHidden.description: Its app is in this PC's hidden-apps list.

hidden.description: Hidden on its own (synced across devices by episode identity).

status.description: The core's summary state, e.g. `pending` or `summarize_failed`.

citations.description:
The entries the answer cited, as saved. Empty for exchanges saved before
citations were stored.

model.description: The model that answered; `None` for exchanges saved before it was stored.

Fact.description:
One learned fact: a single line, with the meeting it was suggested from when it came from a
suggestion.

autostart.description: Windows starts Whimbrel at sign-in (the `Run` entry exists).

autostartAvailable.description: False in debug builds, where the toggle is read-only.

lastReadUnixMs.description: When Whimbrel last read this account's mail, and why the last round failed if it did.

needsReconnect.description:
The stored grant can no longer send: its tokens are gone, or Google did not grant the
permission to send. Connecting the same address again fixes it.

blocked.description: Why Gmail can't be connected right now (no Google client, no Node, connector not staged), or `None`.

id.description: The device's public key: what the choice is stored as.

options.description: The approved devices to choose from, this PC first.

primaryDeviceId.description:
What is stored; empty means any device. A choice that is no longer an approved device is kept
here (it means "any device" to the gate) but not shown as selected.

selected.description: What the picker shows as selected: the stored choice if it is still an option, else empty.

hiddenEpisodeApps.description: Apps whose episodes the Episodes list hides, on this PC only.

LibraryTarget.description: A Library detail view a citation can open (the UI's `Selection`).

McpNewClient.description: Returned once, when a client is made. The token is not recoverable afterwards.

enabled.description: The user's switch. It can be on while the server is not running (it failed).

MeetingModelsStatus.description: Which meeting models are on disk.

missing.description: Display names of the models still missing.

MeetingRecordingView.description: What the UI and the tray show about meeting recording.

degraded.description: Why this recording may be missing audio, while it runs.

failure.description: The last meeting whose transcript or summary failed.

processing.description: The meeting being transcribed or summarized right now, if any (M3.3 Task 4).

MeetingSettings.description: Settings → Meetings: how calls are detected and started.

autoStart.description: Start recording when the alert's countdown ends, instead of waiting. Off by default.

heuristicDetection.description: Watch for calls at all (FR-MTG-2). On by default.

leadMinutes.description: Minutes before a calendar meeting the alert appears, 1–10 (FR-MTG-1).

prepLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before a calendar meeting its Meeting Prep brief is made, 5-120. Kept on this PC.

installed.description: All three files are on disk.

loaded.description: The running store has the model loaded (false until a restart after install).

NextMeetingView.description: The next meeting Today shows, with its brief when one exists.

available.description: Languages Windows can OCR (installed language packs with OCR).

covered.description: Whether the most preferred language has an OCR pack.

profile.description: The user's preferred languages, most preferred first.

PipelineFailure.description: A meeting whose pipeline failed, kept until another one runs.

PrepBriefView.description: A prepared brief, flattened for the card. Claims keep the ids of the sources they rest on.

PrepClaim.description: An open item or question and the ids of the sources it rests on.

PrepSourceView.description: A source the brief cites: the id the claims name ("M1", "E2") and what it was.

meetingId.description:
The meeting on **this** PC the source is, when it provably is one (see `local_meeting`); the
chip opens it. Absent for an email, and for a meeting this PC cannot vouch for.

Processing.description: What the pipeline is doing, for the Meetings tab.

composedChars.description: The block's length before the cap, for the counter. Above `maxChars`, the rest is not sent.

enabled.description: "Use my profile in summaries and answers".

preview.description: "What Whimbrel sees": exactly the block sent with a prompt. Empty when the switch is off.

suggestionsActive.description: Whether the daily job would run now: the suggest switch is on and something is written.

PromptSurface.description:
The LLM call sites that carry their own free-text instructions — the Mac's
`PromptSurface` (`PromptLibrarySettings.swift`). Stored under `prompts.<raw value>`,
the Mac's settings-sync field key; empty means "no extra instructions".

masked.description: The key with all but its last four characters hidden; `None` when unset.

QueueWaitStats.description: How long jobs waited for the store, over the last 4,096 jobs.

RetentionPreview.description:
What a sweep would remove right now, for the first-run notice. The shell's own shape
so it can cross to TypeScript; the numbers are core's.

orphans.description: Recordings no meeting claims any more, and what they take up.

RetentionRun.description: What one sweep removed, for the Settings card.

orphansDeleted.description: Recordings on disk that no meeting claimed any more.

RetentionSettings.description:
Settings → Retention. `None` days means "keep forever", which is how core reads a
missing window too.

RetentionView.description:
The windows, what the last sweep removed, and whether the first-run notice is behind
us — until it is, the schedule counts but never deletes.

RoutineKind.description: The built-in routines, as the UI names them.

autoApprove.description: Whether a write routine acts without a click. Off unless the user turned it on.

schedule.description: `HH:MM`, local time. Unused by Meeting Prep, which is event-driven.

unavailable.description: Why this routine cannot run on this PC yet; the tab shows it and will not let it be switched on.

writes.description: Whether this routine ends in something that needs approving (an event, an email).

RoutingSettings.description: Provider choice, default models and governance, as the Settings UI edits them.

localOnly.description: FR-CHAT-5 local-only mode: Ollama only, whatever else is configured.

userDailyCapCents.description: `None` = the built-in default cap; `Some(0)` = no cap (Mac semantics).

oneOf.description: Waiting for an approval, or being sent right now.

RunView.description: One run, for the history and for a routine's "last ran" line.

originDeviceId.description:
The device that made this run, set only when it was **another** device's (the run synced
here); `None` for a run this PC made.

originLabel.description: That device as a person reads it, for "from <device>".

summary.description: What the routine reported: the brief itself, or why it failed.

appId.description: The §4.3 identity capture stores (normalized); what an exclusion matches.

recordedMeetingId.description: The local meeting recorded for this event, when there is one (recording now or done).

earlierToday.description: Meetings that started today and are not one of the events above, newest first.

events.description: Today's events that are not over yet, soonest first.

recording.description: A meeting is recording now, so no row offers Start.

SnapshotRow.description: A slide-text search hit: a snapshot saved during a meeting (local to this device).

id.description: The `items` row id, as Ask cites it.

SuggestionView.description: A fact the daily job proposed, waiting for Add or Dismiss.

sourceMeetingTitle.description: The meeting it came from, when that meeting still exists.

SyncView.description: What Settings → Sync shows. Never carries the Turso token or database URL.

contentError.description: The last content-sync failure, cleared by the next success.

contentLastSyncedMs.description: When content last synced successfully (Task 6), if it has this session.

briefRecap.description: Today's Daily Brief, when one has run on any device. It is shown in place of the recap.

recap.description: Today's cached recap; `None` until one is generated.

cached.description: Served from the cache, so no model was called this time.

day.description: The local calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the digest cache's key.

emptyDay.description: Nothing to summarize yet today: no model was called and nothing was cached.

TranscriptRow.description: A transcript search hit. Transcript segments carry no device of their own.

startCs.description: Offset from the meeting start, in centiseconds.

TranscriptTurn.description:
A meeting's transcript for display: turns from the file when it's on this device,
else from the stored segments.

more.description: More segments remain beyond this page.

source.description: "file" or "segments" — the segments are what a synced meeting has.

TrayStatus.description: The popup's view of the tray state.

line.description: "Capturing · Synced 2:05 PM", also the tray tooltip.

recordingStartedUnixMs.description: When the recording meeting started, if one is recording.

WorkspaceView.description: One meeting's workspace: what to show, and which parts the user has edited.

conferenceLink.description: The meeting app or conference link, when the row has one.

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds recorded so far, while this process is the one recording.

processingStage.description: "Transcribing…" and friends, while the pipeline is on this meeting.

readOnly.description:
A meeting recorded on another device: its audio isn't here, so it can't be
re-summarized, and Forget would only remove this device's copy.
